audit.finding: All three use Canon Performance sans and mono. IO locally compresses display scale to 2.25–3.25rem; LTD uses a similar reading scale; Space workshop uses 2.25–3.25rem. Agency public headings can reach 4.5rem. These are purpose-specific scales, not a missing font system.
audit.action: Preserve reading/workshop scale and content; no font swap.

audit.finding: All three already opt into Canon operator neutral colors. Local aliases differ: IO panels use operator-panel, LTD and Space panels use operator-secondary. Space still hardcoded hover/active opacity values.
audit.action: Use existing Canon hover/raised and accessible focus tokens in Space. Preserve surface-role distinctions; wider alias consolidation deferred.

audit.finding: IO has a 64px local header, but its hash scroll offset assumed 72px; Space main padding duplicated 72px rather than the shared header token. Reading and workshop section spacing intentionally differs from agency campaign openings.
audit.action: Measure IO nav for hash offset; use Canon header-height token in Space. Preserve route-owned section rhythm.

audit.finding: IO uses Canon editorial navigation/footer; LTD and Space use Canon performance variants. Destinations reflect each property. IO/Space duplicated skip-link markup/styles; LTD main lacked an explicit focus target.
audit.action: Reuse exported Canon SkipToContent in all three; add tabindex=-1 to LTD main. No destination or primary CTA changes.

audit.finding: Property controls/panels hardcoded 6/8/10px while agency uses Canon operator-control (6px) and operator-panel (10px).
audit.action: Consume the existing role tokens in IO/LTD overlays and Space workshop/control styles, including project cards.

audit.finding: Cross-property body entry animation did not guard reduced motion; IO/Space hash scrolling forced smooth motion.
audit.action: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for entry and hash scroll. Keep each property view-transition duration.

audit.finding: Canonical navigation, footer, colors and font families already shared; duplicated local overlay mappings are the larger remaining maintenance opportunity.
audit.action: Reuse existing exports now; defer a new shared alias contract until PR #1992 baseline lands and rendered regression coverage is available.
